description: (0.5.0, Draft) Consumer verification and the key-status mapping (RFC-ACDP-0021 §8). Behavioral, consumer-side; the decision table is the executed kl-001 vector 4.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — all checks pass, identity still listed
B — identity removed from the DID document after signing
C — RFC-ACDP-0014 revocation of the attested fingerprint, receipt before T

expected.behavior: Trust class producer-signed when signed by a DID-document key of the controller; registry-attested when the registry published it. No other class.

scenarios.name: D — same, receipt at or after T
E — attestation retracted by its registry

expected.behavior: Applied as a registry-attested revocation of the attested fingerprint with T = not_before.

scenarios.name: F — no receipt, or a receipt from a registry other than the attester
G — a producer-signed revocation signed by a non-org-wide keyless key

expected.behavior: Not a revocation that speaks for the controller (§9): it does not change the verdict and MAY be reported as a hint.
RFC-ACDP-0014 §8 discovery runs for agent_id = the controller exactly as for any did:web producer; no per-identity or per-key discovery is introduced.

scenarios.name: I — key revocation of a DID-document-era key signed by a keyless key whose attestation is org_wide; signer passes §8.1 steps 1–7
J — same, signer's attestation not org_wide

expected.behavior: Not applied; MAY be reported as a hint (as G).

scenarios.name: K — same, signer not evaluable: consumer without RFC-ACDP-0021 support, attester not accepted (§11), or attestation unavailable

expected.behavior: The revocation lookup is unknown, never not-revoked (RFC-ACDP-0021 §8.1 step 8, RFC-ACDP-0014 §7). A consumer failing closed on unknown refuses the body.

scenarios.name: L — same, signer definitively invalid: attestation hash, signature, receipt or §5.3 failure, a step 3–6 failure, or the attestation withdrawn

expected.behavior: Ignored, as any RFC-ACDP-0014 revocation whose signature fails; the verdict is unchanged.

scenarios.name: M — the attesting registry has rotated the key that signed the attestation: the key is in its current verificationMethod but no longer in assertionMethod, and the attestation's receipt verifies with key_fingerprint equal to that key

expected.behavior: Step 1 passes via the RFC-ACDP-0010 §10 historical arm. The keyless body's status is decided by steps 8–9 as usual (currently or historically authorized, or pre-compromise); the retired attester key does not lower it.

scenarios.name: N — same, but the retired key has been removed from verificationMethod entirely (compromise)

expected.behavior: Fails closed regardless of the attestation's receipt.
